sources.title: RackNerd New York: NYRN305KVM physical-node incident, November 9, 2026
sources.summary: The original November 9 New York incident reports actual connectivity problems on node NYRN305KVM and subsequently states that the issue is resolved. RackNerd defines a node/hypervisor as a physical server hosting VPS instances. Joined to its exact New York facility address, this supports existing commercial hosting at 325 Delaware Avenue. It does not establish a new opening, expansion, commissioned capacity or a whole-site outage.

extraction.timestamp_basis: Original abbr data-timeago attribute explicitly gives -08:00; the visible calendar date November 9 is retained as status_as_of. No local Buffalo timezone is assumed.
extraction.resolution_date: The original body reports resolution without a separate dated update; no exact resolution timestamp is asserted.
extraction.scope: Actual one-node connectivity incident establishes deployed physical hosting. The status-page explanation expressly distinguishes node issues from site-wide service loss.
extraction.successor_review: The captured original RackNerd status page was reviewed through November 11. Its latest listed New York incident is NYRN305KVM, dated November 9 at 23:27 with explicit HTML offset -08:00; later listed November 10 incidents concern other locations. The selected incident body reports resolution without a separately dated update. The current New York component is operational and reports its last update as November 9 at 23:34:51 without an explicit offset; that component timestamp is not substituted for the selected physical observation. March 27, 2026 original ColoCrossing expansion completion remains older context, not a new November opening. No contrary relocation or closure was found in this bounded original host/status review; no exhaustive corporate-history claim is made.

extraction.identity_join: The provider uses the same New York Datacenter label on its facility and status pages; its exact Buffalo address equals the separate ColoCrossing BUF1 operator address. This is a physical-building identity join, not an independently established floor, suite or rack location.
extraction.scope: Current original address identity only. No performance guarantee, certification, opening year, renewable share, service capacity or suite equivalence is selected.
extraction.distinctness_review: All four committed baseline 154 identity layers were searched: 1,302 sites, 1,412 projects, 231 source records, and 231 identity-mapping records plus 231 decisions. ColoCrossing, BUF1/BUF-1, 325 Delaware, Velocity Servers, HostPapa, RackNerd/NYRN, ServerMania, Nexeon, Deluxe, Benchmark Group and Buffalo aliases, plus nearby 350 Main Street and 5319 Enterprise Drive, produce no matches. All 1,302 full geometries, including polygons and multipolygons, were compared. The nearest represented host is TeraWulf Lake Mariner, 55.250 km away. The original Cogent service list identifies ColoCrossing BUF1 and CenturyLink at 325 Delaware, and separately places 365 and Shatter IT at 350 Main Street. These are colocated-provider aliases or different physical addresses, not reasons to create additional sites. One existing physical 325 Delaware host is proposed; no separate customer, suite, server or expansion host is inferred.
